rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for cancelling an order, plan, event, or programme.

example.english: I want to cancel tomorrow's gathering.
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 ceoi2 siu1 ting1 jat6 go3 zeoi6 wui2

rows.note: Use this when one effect offsets or neutralizes another, such as noise or a force.

example.english: The two forces cancel each other out.
example.jyutping: loeng5 gu2 lik6 loeng6 wu6 soeng1 dai2 siu1 zo2

rows.note: Use this specifically when a television or radio programme is taken off the air.

example.english: The TV station will cancel this programme next month.
example.traditional: 電視台下個月會將呢個節目停播。
example.jyutping: din6 si6 toi4 haa6 go3 jyut6 wui5 zoeng1 ni1 go3 zit3 muk6 ting4 bo3

rows.note: Use this for officially marking a postage stamp or similar item so it cannot be reused.

example.english: The post office will cancel the stamp.
example.traditional: 郵局會喺張郵票上蓋銷。
example.jyutping: jau4 guk6 wui5 hai2 zoeng1 jau4 piu3 soeng6 gap3 siu1
